description: Yummy Toddler Food animal crackers: the whole web page copied and pasted (menus, story, a short ingredient list near the top, the recipe card, and many reader comments). Tricky parts: the short list near the top leaves out salt and vanilla, which only the recipe card has; comments suggest cinnamon, cocoa, flax, sprinkles, baby cereal, and oat milk, none of which are in the recipe. Recipe card: 7 ingredients, 6 steps, 12 servings (about 2 dozen very small cookies), 17 minutes total.
